The founding belief

Mental health still runs on self-report.
We are building the missing feedback loop.

A person can say “I’m fine.” Today, a human professional or AI has to infer what is actually happening. Neuro adds synchronized physiological feedback to the conversation, so the system can observe a reaction, adapt, and measure what happens next.

How it works

One continuous loop, not a dashboard.

01

Assess

Before a session begins, Neuro checks whether the user is appropriate for an AI-led session. If not, it refuses and routes the user toward human support.

02

Talk

A voice AI conducts a structured session. Hundreds of agents cross-check safety, context, and compliance with a clinician-designed protocol.

03

Measure

The sensing band records physiological arousal and forehead tension while the session is happening.

04

Adapt

The system can slow down, pause, stay with a topic, or change technique, then measure the response to that decision.

Voice+Physiology→State estimate→AI response→Measured reaction

Unexpected user segment

People over 50 became Neuro’s largest segment. Speaking is easier and less embarrassing than typing for users who are uncomfortable with apps or written communication.

The sensing layer

Built for conversation, not meditation.

Speaking contaminates frontal EEG with facial and jaw-muscle artifacts. Neuro therefore combines frontal electrical sensing with skin conductance, which remains usable while a person is speaking.

  • Signal stackFrontal electrical sensing + EDA
  • ElectrodesDry, user-wearable
  • ConnectivityBluetooth
  • Weight70–80 g
  • StimulationNone
Passive sensing only.No tDCS, tACS, CES, or other electrical stimulation circuitry.
Prototype statusBuilt and working
N

Safety by architecture

An AI that knows when not to talk.

General-purpose chatbots are designed to continue. Neuro assesses the user before a session and continuously checks whether the session should proceed. When the situation is outside its scope, it stops and directs the user to human support.

In one real case, the system refused to proceed when it detected symptoms consistent with an active panic attack and directed the user toward professional help.

What is different

The signal is not an output.
It is an input that changes the conversation.

AI mental health products
  • Talk to the user
  • Rely mostly on self-report
  • Do not use synchronized physiology
Neuro
  • Conducts structured voice sessions
  • Reads synchronized physiological response
  • Adapts the session and measures what follows
Consumer neurotechnology
  • Measures signals
  • Produces scores and feedback
  • Does not conduct a live structured session

The compounding asset

A paired dataset of decisions and reactions.

Each sensor-enabled session can create a sequence that no standalone chatbot or wearable collects.

  1. 01What the user said
  2. 02What the AI did
  3. 03How physiology reacted
  4. 04How the session adapted
  5. 05What happened afterward

The conversational side exists today. The synchronized physiological side begins accumulating when devices reach users.

What we test next

We have not yet proven that physiology improves outcomes.

Our first controlled study will compare identical sessions with and without the real signal reaching the model. If the signal does not improve outcomes or retention, the core voice product still works without it. We intend to learn this within months, not build for years around an untested claim.
